HE E.1 he-phys-sekii-e-1-b06-a01-276db5cc and b07-a01-5e3ee94d: constant acceleration and its definition; b13-a01-7e980f65: relationship of time-position and time-speed laws from diagrams. BW3.3.5.1(4) limits quantitative a-t to s-t derivation.

HE E.2 he-phys-sekii-e-2-b13-a01-cbc0a0dc concerns inelastic collision and resulting energy conversions; it supplies no universal Math edge. The current canonical description explicitly requires qualitative accounting.
